comments: Reports distinguish machine-verified findings from AI-assisted advisory findings, and reference findings against EN 301 549 and national EAA transpositions (e.g. BFSG, RGAA criteria references) alongside WCAG.
features: Automated WCAG 2.1 AA audits for business websites: deterministic checks (axe-core, keyboard, contrast, PDF) plus AI-assisted review of semantic criteria. Reports separate machine-verified findings from advisory ones, include suggested fixes and an accessibility score, and reference EU requirements (EAA, EN 301 549).
title: geta11y
